skill.name: creative-media
skill.description: Use Creative Media to create and manage AI-generated images, edits, video, audio, and image-to-3D assets through the Image Skill hosted runtime. It provides CLI and API workflows with hosted URLs, recoverable jobs, cost receipts, and feedback tracking.
skill.summary: Create and manage hosted AI media assets through the Image Skill runtime.
skill.author: danielgwilson

security_audit.summary: The skill is a hosted creative media workflow with external command, network, and filesystem touchpoints. The main concern is line 28, which tells agents to run a command returned by hosted service data. No prompt injection language was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Remote response field can select a local command.
remediation.suggestion: Require agents to display the exact command, allow only image-skill subcommands, and get explicit user approval before execution.

remediation.issue: npx examples execute packages from the network.
remediation.suggestion: Pin package versions, document package provenance, and provide an install-free API path for cautious users.

remediation.issue: Hosted API and payment workflow may receive prompts and job data.
remediation.suggestion: Document retention, privacy, cost limits, and consent requirements before paid media creation.

remediation.issue: Hidden workspace state changes HOME and CODEX_HOME.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that this is shell-scoped and prefer local installs when global skill state is not needed.

content.user_title: Create AI Media Through Image Skill
content.value_statement: Creative teams need one workflow for generated images, edits, video, audio, and 3D assets. This skill routes agents through Image Skill commands that return hosted media URLs, job recovery data, and cost details.
actual_capabilities: Introduces Image Skill as a hosted runtime for image generation, editing, video, audio, and image-to-3D tasks.
Provides a no-spend guide command before paid media creation.
Shows a command for listing available models as JSON.
Installs the creative-media or canonical image-skill entry through skills.sh.
Documents hosted URLs for the skill, LLM contract, CLI contract, and API.
Recommends feedback submission when a needed media capability is missing.
limitations: Full media creation depends on the Image Skill hosted service.
The examples use npx commands that download and execute packages.
Media generation may spend credits when creation commands run.
The skill does not provide local model weights or offline generation.

use_cases.title: Generate campaign visuals
use_cases.description: Create hosted images or edits for campaign concepts while keeping receipt and recovery details available.

use_cases.title: Prototype media assets
use_cases.description: Explore image, video, audio, or 3D asset options from one agent workflow before choosing a provider.

use_cases.title: Centralize agent media work
use_cases.description: Use one runtime for media jobs, model discovery, hosted links, and feedback across agent sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Start with a no-spend guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Use creative-media to plan an AI image for [subject]. Run the no-spend guide first and ask before any paid creation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare available models
prompt_templates.scenario: Model discovery before choosing a media path
prompt_templates.prompt: Use creative-media to list available media models. Summarize which options fit my goal: [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Edit an existing asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Use creative-media to prepare an edit plan for this image: [image]. Show the prompt, expected output, and cost before creation.

prompt_templates.title: Run a multi-modal asset workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use creative-media to plan image, video, audio, and 3D outputs for [project]. Track hosted links, job recovery data, and receipts.

output_examples.input: Create a product concept image for a compact field camera.
output_examples.output: The assistant proposes a refined prompt, starts with the no-spend guide, asks for approval, then returns a hosted image link.

output_examples.input: Find models that can make short launch videos.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks available models and summarizes suitable video options, expected tradeoffs, and any missing requirements.

output_examples.input: Image Skill lacks the asset type I need.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains the gap, suggests a fallback for that task, and prepares a feedback report for the hosted service.

best_practices: Start with the no-spend guide before any media creation.
Review every generated command before execution, especially commands returned by service data.
Keep hosted URLs, receipts, and job recovery details with the project notes.
anti_patterns: Running paid generation commands before the user approves cost and output goals.
Sending private source images or sensitive prompts without checking data handling requirements.
Executing a returned command without validating that it matches the intended Image Skill action.

faq.question: Does this skill run local media models?
faq.answer: No. It uses the hosted Image Skill runtime and does not include local model weights.

faq.question: Does it require provider API keys?
faq.answer: The skill says provider API keys are not required. It uses Image Skill identity and wallet workflows instead.

faq.question: Can it create video and audio?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes image, edit, video, audio, and image-to-3D capabilities through the same runtime.

faq.question: Will it always spend credits?
faq.answer: No. It includes a no-spend guide command, but creation commands may spend credits after approval.

faq.question: Is it safe to execute every suggested command?
faq.answer: No. Review commands first, especially commands returned by hosted service data or npx package downloads.

faq.question: What happens when a needed capability is missing?
faq.answer: The skill recommends using a fallback only for that gap and sending feedback to Image Skill.
